messages:
Aisha Khan: quick design Q — compact spend canvas: org/project toggle + invoice download placement. screenshot: https://redwood.app/ux/shot/1854321000.png
Ben Carter: my vote is row-level download. accountants expect per-line export. toolbar download feels global/confusing. :thinking_face:
Eva Li: row-level is fine but accessibility needs: each download button must include SR text with the org/project and period. also keyboard target size.
Samir Patel: fyi row-level download increases DOM nodes (virtualized list) — we can make it a delegated action (single button per row id) to avoid hydration issues. perf caveat.
Aisha Khan: what about a hybrid? selected-row sticky toolbar: shows Download invoice (row) + Download all (toolbar). keeps discoverability and reduces per-row buttons.
Ben Carter: hybrid seems promising. still think primary CTA for invoices should be near the row content. secondary on toolbar.
Eva Li: agree. UX nit: token breakdown placement — popover vs inline expand. popover keeps density but can be hard for keyboard users. inline expand is long.
Samir Patel: implementation note: inline expand ok if we lazy-load contents. popover should manage focus trap and escape. both doable.
Aisha Khan: accessibility nit for popover: screen reader should announce "Tokens for <org/project> — estimated cost" on open.
ProductBot: Experiment launched: /ab-test create "invoice-download-placement" variant=A_row_download variant=B_toolbar_primary link: https://redwood.app/experiments/32
Eva Li: copy suggestions: toolbar label -> "Download invoices (selected)"; row label -> "Download invoice (PDF)". clearer than generic "Download".
Ben Carter: +1 to including format in label. also show file size estimate? maybe overkill.
Samir Patel: ARIA proposal for row button: ```html
<button aria-label="Download invoice for Acme Corp — March 2025 (PDF)" data-row-id="r-123">Download</button>
```
Aisha Khan: perfect. can we add sr-only text that includes billing scope? e.g., "Invoice for Acme Corp, project: Payments"
Eva Li: yes, use visually-hidden CSS class and keep visible label concise.
ProductBot: reminder: AB test will run for 7 days and collect download events + engagement.
Ben Carter: follow-up acceptance criteria for hybrid: 1) keyboard navigable; 2) SR reads scope; 3) virtualization perf not degraded (>95th percentile render).
Samir Patel: noted. I'll prototype with delegated click handler + requestIdleCallback for breakdown content.
Aisha Khan: thanks team — I'll update the mock and push to Figma. tagging @Eva for final microcopy.
Eva Li: will iterate and post updated frames by EOD. :sparkles:
